lines.speaker: Delwyn
lines.text: Here to hunt, are ya? That makes two of us. Name's Delwyn. See that there? No, your eyes don't deceive ya. That... is the Spirit. Or at least, a form of it. Don't worry—it means for us to follow. Approach, and the hunt begins.

lines.speaker: Delwyn
lines.text: Spirit's breath... It's you. Weren't sure I'd ever see you again after... well, you know. Some said you were dead. Part o' me almost wished it—easier than wonderin' where you went... or how to reckon with what you did.

lines.speaker: Delwyn
lines.text: I see you don't hang about—nice work on that hunt. Name's Delwyn. Hope you're friendlier than the Ezoymtes I've met so far—though seein' as you've not tried to cave my head in yet, I'd say we're off to a fine start.

lines.speaker: Delwyn
lines.text: Spirit's breath... It really is you. Thought me eyes were playin' tricks when I saw you run past. Weren't sure I'd ever see you again after...well, you know. Some said you were dead. Part o' me almost wished it—easier than wonderin' where you went... or how to reckon with what you did.
